translationLines.originalJapaneseLine: 「は、はは、面白い奴でしょ？

translationLines.translatedEnglishLine: 「Hmm, someone immune to my Dread Miasma.

translationLines.translatedEnglishLine: Well, it's a present from my apostle.

なんとか機嫌直してもらえたにゃん……」

translationLines.translatedEnglishLine: Never thought my avatar would get beaten.」

translationLines.translatedEnglishLine: but among humans he's pretty capable.」

translationLines.originalJapaneseLine: 「儂が動ければ……

translationLines.translatedEnglishLine: I would go myself and deal with them...」

translationLines.originalJapaneseLine: 「そうにゃ、そうにゃ。

translationLines.translatedEnglishLine: You just laze around here all the time nya.

ケイブニャンの無責任な言葉に

translationLines.translatedEnglishLine: 「He'd probably lose to some random ruronta.」

translationLines.translatedEnglishLine: at the sword stabbed into his collarbone.

translationLines.translatedEnglishLine: That is the cause of my weakness.」

translationLines.translatedEnglishLine: 「Because of this sword that was stabbed into me during the previous Faction War,

translationLines.translatedEnglishLine: I can only live by using my full strength.」

translationLines.translatedEnglishLine: 「Guahaha! The guy who was once the strongest monster

translationLines.originalJapaneseLine: 本当に愉快そうに、

translationLines.translatedEnglishLine: Kayblis laughed in a voice that made everyone around uncomfortable.
